statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229
The claim was denied under CO-197 for failure to obtain required prior authorization
The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea prompting evaluation for underlying rhythm disturbances
There was clinical suspicion of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified arrhythmias
The study was ordered to capture and characterize the cardiac rhythm over an extended period
The diagnosis codes submitted were I49.9 and I48.91
